feedback.headline: Training has plateaued around ~60% destruction (1-star perimeter clearing) for over 3,500 episodes due to NoOp collapse, spatial pointer entropy saturation, and premature action dumping.
feedback.progression_summary: While mean destruction edged up slightly from 54.52% (First 50 eps) to 60.90% in Phase 5 (eps 7017–8770) with a recent 300-episode slope of +0.782%/100ep, the policy is sitting -6.0% below its rolling-50 peak of 65.5% reached at episode 6252 (2,518 episodes ago) and hasn't beaten its 90% single-episode best since episode 3811 (4,959 episodes ago). Crucially, 1+ star consistency reached 92.2% in Phase 5, but the 2+ star Town Hall takedown rate collapsed to 4.0% in the recent 50 episodes with a 0.0% 3-star rate across all 8,770 episodes.

what_is_going_wrong.title: Premature Action Dumping & Complete NoOp Collapse
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: NoOp usage collapsed from 43.97% (First 50 eps) to 0.11% (Recent 50 eps), compressing episode length from 71.7 steps to 36.3 steps. Hero abilities fire at ticks 40–64 (first 4–6 seconds), spells cast at ticks 120–256, and all troops are exhausted by tick 320 (~32s into a 180s battle).
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: The combination of a -0.04 step penalty on NoOp, a +0.035 step bonus on active actions, and immediate end-of-battle reward realization via finish_battle() upon inventory exhaustion creates a severe temporal discounting and shaping bias. GAE assigns higher advantage to policies that spam every available troop, spell, and hero ability immediately to collect step bonuses and trigger the terminal destruction payout without discount decay, preventing the agent from waiting for units to path into the TH18 core before popping abilities or spells.

what_is_going_wrong.title: Factorized Head Entropy Imbalance & Spatial Scattering
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: Total entropy appears healthy at 6.855, but per-head probes reveal tile_xy entropy is at 6.813 (101.0% saturation, top-5 tiles holding only 3.14% probability mass, spatial spread std = 16.67 tiles, unique tile ratio = 0.96), whereas discrete heads have collapsed: slot_idx is at 11.3% saturation (0.260), slot_type at 25.1% (0.489, with 97.5% initial prob on Hero), and deploy_fraction at 30.2% (0.486, with 95.8% on the 25% bin).
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: Weighting the summed joint entropy H = H(type) + H(idx) + H(frac) + H(tile_xy) with a single scalar ent_coef (0.015) allows the 2,500-way spatial head (max entropy ~6.74–7.82 nats) to dominate the entropy bonus. The optimizer satisfies the entropy objective by keeping tile selection nearly uniform across the perimeter while collapsing the low-dimensional discrete heads into rigid, deterministic micro-deployment loops (repeatedly deploying 25% stacks).

what_is_going_wrong.title: Failure to Funnel into TH18 Core (1-Star Local Optimum)
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: 1+ star rate is 84.0%–92.2%, but 2+ star Town Hall takedown rate is only 4.0% in the recent 50 episodes (9.7% in Phase 5) and 3-star rate is 0.0% over 8,770 episodes.
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: Uniform perimeter scattering (std 16.67 tiles) combined with 25% fractional troop trickling reliably clears exterior trash buildings to cross the 50% 1-star threshold, creating a low-variance local optimum (~45–48 reward). Because TH18 core defenses (Hot Candle, Rage Towers, Multi-Infernos) require concentrated multi-unit funneling and delayed spell/ability timing, scattered deployments die before breaching the core.

what_is_going_wrong.title: Multi-Army Policy Interference & Value Under-Calibration
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: Thrower + Healer Smash achieves 64.9% recent destruction (1.12 stars, 51.86 reward), whereas Dragon Duke Hydra lags at 53.6% (0.76 stars, 40.94 reward). Meanwhile, the critic under-predicts initial return by -5.54 (V(s0) = 40.13 vs 45.67 empirical return) with high rollout variance across small batch sizes (batch_episodes = 4).
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: Randomly sampling 3 distinct meta armies across 5 base layouts with only 4 episodes per PPO update causes high variance in value targets and gradient interference between ground-smash funneling and air-hydra spell timing.

recommendations.action: Remove the -0.04 NoOp penalty and +0.035 active action bonus (set both to 0.0), and apply γ-discounting over the fast-forwarded ticks inside finish_battle() (or credit damage step-by-step during simulation) so early action dumping no longer gets an artificial undiscounted advantage.
recommendations.target: step reward shaping & finish_battle() credit assignment
recommendations.rationale: Eliminates the perverse incentive to dump all spells and hero abilities in the first 6–25 seconds, allowing the policy to use NoOp (Wait) to hold spells and hero abilities until troops engage high-DPS core defenses.

recommendations.action: Replace the single scalar ent_coef = 0.015 with normalized per-head entropy coefficients (divide each head's entropy by log(N_valid_actions) before weighting, or set ent_coef_discrete = 0.03 for slot_type/slot_idx/deploy_fraction and ent_coef_tile = 0.002 for tile_xy).
recommendations.rationale: Prevents the 2,500-tile spatial head from hijacking the entropy bonus, forcing the spatial pointer to sharpen onto coherent funnel entry points while restoring exploration in troop selection, NoOp timing, and 100% full-stack deployments.

recommendations.action: Add an explicit Town Hall damage shaping bonus (e.g., +0.15 per 1% HP removed from TH18 and +10.0 on TH takedown) and proximity/core-destruction weighting.
recommendations.rationale: Bridges the sparse credit-assignment gap between clearing 50% perimeter trash buildings and penetrating the heavily defended TH18 center, guiding the spatial head to concentrate deployments along a single attack vector.

recommendations.action: Increase batch_episodes from 4 to 16 (or 32) and decay lr from 0.0003 to 0.00015.
recommendations.rationale: With 3 armies x 5 villages (15 matchup combinations), a 4-episode batch undersamples the matchup matrix every update, causing critic miscalibration (-5.54 gap) and cross-army gradient oscillation.

detected_signals.detail: Single shared ent_coef across summed head entropies allows the 2500-tile spatial pointer head to stay near-uniform (scattering units across the perimeter) while discrete heads (slot_type, slot_idx, deploy_fraction) collapse to near-deterministic distributions.
Policy reliably clears perimeter trash buildings for 1★ (>50% destruction) but rarely funnels concentrated power into the Town Hall 18 core.
